_readme: Machine-readable source verification ledger. Every URL cited in the requirement documents was verified on 2026-10-23 by fetching it and reading its own title/channel/identity. Verdicts: OFFICIAL (the game's own material), THIRD_PARTY (genuinely about Super Citycon but not the developer), LEGIT (valid non-video source), PLATFORM (generic Steam-platform behaviour, not game-specific), FOREIGN (a DIFFERENT GAME - rows citing only these are invalid), WEAK (real but cannot currently be quoted), JUNK (not a source). See docs/SOURCE-VERIFICATION.md for the full narrative and the proof for each verdict.

verdicts.OFFICIAL: The game's own material (official YouTube channel, official site, official store/app pages, official community).
verdicts.THIRD_PARTY: Independently produced but genuinely about Super Citycon.
verdicts.LEGIT: Valid primary source that is not a video.
verdicts.PLATFORM: Generic platform behaviour (e.g. Steam Workshop mechanics). Not evidence about SuperCitycon specifics.
verdicts.FOREIGN: Belongs to a DIFFERENT GAME. Any requirement whose only support is a FOREIGN source is invalid.
verdicts.WEAK: Real and relevant, but the body cannot currently be read, so it cannot be quoted as evidence.
verdicts.JUNK: Not a source (search-engine query URL, bare domain).

index.commoncrawl.org.proof: Common Crawl index API, used to retrieve an archived capture of the official dev blog article https://supercitycon.net/new-bonuses-for-residence-growth/ (which now returns 404). Query 'CC-MAIN-2024-51-index?url=supercitycon.net%2Fnew-bonuses-for-residence-growth%2F&output=json' returns status 200, mime text/html, timestamp 20241213091112, with the WARC filename/offset/length needed to fetch the exact bytes. The recovered article text is the publisher's own words.
